source.observations: SkillCorner broadcast detections (is_detected) at 1 Hz; provider extrapolations discarded
source.on_pitch_basis: match-sheet playing time (provider lists nobody during replays / close-ups; players are estimated there)
source.reconstruction_trained_on: DFL (7 Bundesliga matches); never on this match
source.event_feed: SkillCorner dynamic events (provider CV-derived); goals from score changes; xG from simulator model
source.uncertainty: DFL-calibrated 80% radius; broadcast-domain coverage measured on GSR/SkillCorner re-entries, see docs/reconstruction_evaluation.md

uncertainty_validated.basis: SkillCorner A-League re-entries (proxy truth = provider detections), model r13_mlp_aug_ens3_final
uncertainty_validated.live_p5_calibration: predicted vs observed within 0.03 in every bin
uncertainty_validated.applies_to: estimated players only; measured positions remain unverified

source.warning: Hidden players are model estimates, not observations. Identity and positions of observed players are SkillCorner's, not independently verified.
